title: Add newly-required constructor parameter and forward to base (CS7036)
problemSignature: CS7036: There is no argument given that corresponds to the required parameter '<name>' of '<CoreType>'

requiredRepoCharacteristics: client subclass overrides a Core base constructor

exclusions: Do not invent the parameter type. Read the required parameter from the decompiled installed DLL signature; the DLL is authoritative.
Do not change the client override body.
rootCauseHypothesis: Core added a required constructor dependency; the client subclass constructor and its base() call must forward the new parameter.
proposedActions: Decompile the Core base type to read the new constructor signature.
Add the matching parameter to the client subclass constructor.
Forward it in the base(...) call.
Register the new dependency in DI if it is not already registered.
Rebuild and confirm the CS7036 family reaches zero.
